t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes in total that compete in pairs - usually red v yellow and green v pink. It generally runs for about 4 rounds before it changes and pay close attention to the multipliers - you can yield 5 in a x1 multiplier

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes in total split into two teams:yellow, orange, blue and green - these use a yellow basketred, pink, purple and brown - these use a red basketThey go against each other in pairs:yellow v redgreen v pinkorange v brownblue v pinkFor me, the yellow basket seemed to give a higher score so I tried to stick to selecting the yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes.
